unit.meaning: A unit in the PID 2 routine seat's unit_enum, not observe-only, named in exactly one registered routine. Used only when routine_id is absent.

routine_id.meaning: Alternative target field; when present it takes precedence over unit, and its value is looked up as a unit name, not a routine identifier.

ok.meaning: Whether the queue request completed successfully.

scope.meaning: The selected unit's scope from the PID 2 routine seat.

life.meaning: The program lifecycle state queued by this request, Queued.

readback.meaning: PID 2 status for the unit, including its registration, hold, lines and programs when available.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Outcome signal. Fixed refusals include pid2-door-busy, pid2-door-task-failed, protocol-envelope-not-object, protocol-schema-mismatch, pid2-schema-seat-missing, pid2-unit-not-declared, pid2-unit-observe-only, pid2-unit-scope-missing, pid2-action-lock-poisoned, pid2-database-lock-poisoned, pid2-unit-registration-ambiguous, pid2-unit-not-registered and pid2-routine-held. Parsing, lock, storage, wake and status errors can also contain variable diagnostic text; success uses none in final_receipt.
